title: Planet Neptune and Remedies
sub: Complete notes on Jyotish Vidya Ep. 25 by Brajesh Gautam, The Anchor Of Life. Neptune (Varuna) in sign 7, in each sign, with each planet, thread colours, the west of the home and a live chart.
desc: Complete notes on Jyotish Vidya Ep. 25, Planet Neptune and Remedies by Brajesh Gautam: Neptune by sign and conjunction, thread remedies, the west direction, Q&A and video timestamps.
points: Neptune is the sea of never enough.
Unlimited money, love, drink and illusion. In his own sign, it works as boundless grace or boundless chaos.
Each planet in sign 7 gets a sea reading.
Sun, Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, Saturn, Rahu, Ketu, Indra and Pluto, each with a result and a caution.
Its effect is subtle and constant, and the stone given is blue aquamarine.
Water signs best, earth friendly, fire signs most negative.
Light blue, ink blue, purple, red and yellow threads, ink and tattoos, plus buried seawater and tea leaves.
The west of the home is Varuna's.
No door in W5 or W6, keep it clean, place the ishta image, and leave the wish.
Drink, bribes, tax evasion, a stolen-from-home remark, and health comments are flagged and not endorsed.
